_about: What each app is about, in words. The model marks a file with the apps it is about; each app takes the files marked for it; the apps are served in this order; and a mail is shown to the model only when it has an amount of money together with one of an app's terms. Add an app, a language or a word here: nothing in the code names an app or a kind of document.
